name: configs-sync
description: configs-sync engine (#1148): the fleet's configs pipeline as its own container. On a schedule it checks out cloud-u-containers (the declared inputs) and cloud-t-infra (the derive code, 1_cloud-configs), regenerates the consolidated JSON, the per-app build-*.json and the C3 containers-declared.json, runs the containers guard, and commits the result to the public data repo cloud_db_infra-ops-obsv_configs-sync. c3-infra-api and cloud-infra-mcp serve those files from the data repo. CANONICAL: the derivation of containers-declared.json lives HERE (src/code/containers-declared.mjs); the consolidated and per-app derivation stays in cloud-t-infra 1_cloud-configs, which this engine runs. cloud-t-infra keeps generating into its own dist/ as a thin wrapper until this engine is live.

native_build.cmd: apk add --no-cache bash git jq curl tzdata nodejs npm && npm install -g tsx yaml ajv ajv-formats nunjucks && chmod +x /app/entrypoint.sh
